scope: Owned namespace with Now and standalone Date bridge, conditional global installation, force installation and detection. Owned ICU4X calendar and IANA 2026f timezone data included except detection. Forced temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 full/implementation reference uses host Intl and has broader locale integration; basic ISO/Gregorian implementation entry measured separately. Size only; prior throughput and primitive WASM profiles remain separate. Bundles are alternatives, not additive.
method: Bazel Rolldown bundles, esbuild es2022 minification, gzip level 9; byte lengths include newline.

publishedGraphs.scope: Required ESM files compressed separately. Consumer bundling can remove unused code. WASM backend delegates ISO/Instant/PlainTime/calendar/timezone/Duration math; all16 native calendar tables and IANA records plus retained TS algorithms/data included. Source maps, declarations and notices are not runtime imports.

primitiveProfile.scope: Matched data-free Instant/Duration primitives only, not full facades or calendars/timezones. Prior throughput measurements remain separate.
